note: 12h chaos soak on the #4125/#4128 fixes plus batch-lifecycle instrumentation (eedd47685). Retention window (10m/4096) keeps committed batches fetchable; re-delivered certificates are skipped instead of waited on. New metrics: certificates_redelivered_total (must stay 0 — nonzero means commit dedup is still wrong upstream and the fix is masking it), retention hits/expired/held for window sizing, batch_waits_total by reason, and blocks_produced vs blocks_empty to tell an idle network from a wedged one. stallkill now refuses to count an idle stretch against its threshold, after it killed the previous run four minutes in during the loadgen bootstrap wait.
